record.purpose: Find the relevant county office and verify incumbent and jurisdiction before any correspondence. This is not a confirmed separate recipient.

sources.source_title: Published county office and professional contact evidence
sources.stated_purpose: Non-sensitive county legal administrative correspondence within documented jurisdiction and office remit.
sources.limitations: County page identifies officeholder; State Bar profile supplies the work address. County explicitly excludes filing claims and service of documents through its website. Internal departmental legal service request mailbox not substituted. County counsel represents the county, not a private complainant. Do not infer independent complaint intake, legal filing or service-of-process authorization. Confirm role, mailbox and remit before use. Deliverability not tested.
